decision.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.955) with minimal seasonality (0.065) and high predictability. Catboost, as a gradient-boosted tree model, captures the monotonic trend structure without needing seasonal decomposition. The 20x relative error spread and moderate ranking instability (Kendall tau 0.431) mean that combining catboost with weaker, correlated-error models (14 groups, only 9 independent) only injects their error. The separated margin (0.385) over the best combination confirms that no averaging strategy can improve on the single model for this trend-dominated, highly predictable series.
